description: Popup menu panel for selecting one or multiple options.

single.indicator: Exactly one check icon is visible when a value is selected.

multiple.indicator: Checkbox state is independent for every option.

selection_behavior.focus: Arrow-key focus is transient and must not change aria-selected, value, selected background semantics or check icons.
selection_behavior.placeholder: Placeholder belongs to the Selector trigger and must not be inserted into the Dropdown option collection.
selection_behavior.reopen: Focus the selected option; if none is selected, focus the first enabled option.

viewport_behavior.width: At least the trigger width; expand for content within viewport constraints.
viewport_behavior.overflow: Scroll the option region only; never let an ancestor clip the popup.

dynamic_options: Synchronize selection by stable value. Remove missing single values and restore the trigger placeholder; remove only invalid values in multiple mode.
